Enterprise WebRTC/RTP RFC 5761 rtcp-mux PT [64, 95] Collision & Odd-Port Reclamation
Deterministic PT [64, 95] Exclusion + Dynamic [96, 127] (P1057) & RTP+1 Odd-Port Reclamation + Same-IP a=rtcp (P1058 🎉)
❌ UNPROTECTED RFC 5761 RTCP-MUX
1. PT=72 + Talkspurt Marker=1 -> Byte 1 = 200 (RTCP SR!)
RTP M=1, PT=72 -> Byte1 = 128 + 72 = 200 == RTCP SR ❌
• 23 talkspurt-start audio packets misrouted into RTCP parser
• Clips the first 20ms syllable of every caller utterance
2. Leaked RTP+1 Odd Sockets & Cross-IP a=rtcp SSRF
a=rtcp-mux active, but RTP+1 (20001) left bound (2 sockets/track)
• 16 leaked odd ports or cross-IP a=rtcp:53 amplification targets
• Exhausts 50% of media gateway UDP ephemeral port pool
Production Impact Without P1057 / P1058 🎉
• Systematic first-word ASR recognition errors on every sentence
• Premature UDP port exhaustion & RTCP reflection DDoS exposure
✅ STAGE 532 DETERMINISTIC GUARDRAILS (P1057–P1058 🎉)
P1057 (1,066th Guard): Exclude PT [64, 95] & Clamp [96, 127]
action: "exclude_reserved_pt_64to95_and_clamp_dynamic_pt_range"
• Forbids PT [64, 95] so M=1 never collides with RTCP 192..223
• Clamps rtcpByte1CollidingTalkspurtPackets = 0
• Clamps negotiatedDynamicRtpPayloadType in [96, 127] (72 -> 96)
Policy ID: P1057-WEBRTC-RFC5761-RTCP-MUX-RESERVED-PT-64TO95-EXCLUSION-AND-DYNAMIC-RANGE-GUARD
P1058 🎉 (535th Dim 🎉): Reclaim RTP+1 & Same-IP a=rtcp Gate
action: "reclaim_odd_rtcp_port_and_block_cross_ip_rtcp_ssrf"
• Closes RTP+1 odd socket on rtcp-mux & blocks cross-IP a=rtcp
• Clamps leakedOddRtcpPortsOrCrossIpSsrfTargetsCount = 0
• Clamps allocatedUdpSocketsPerRtcpMuxTrack in [1, 1] (2 -> 1)
Policy ID: P1058-WEBRTC-RFC5761-RTCP-ATTRIBUTE-SAME-IP-BINDING-AND-ODD-PORT-RECLAMATION-GUARD
